prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis — the right agency depends on your organization’s size, specialty (hospital, clinic, med device, senior care, behavioral health, B2B vs B2C), goals (brand awareness, patient acquisition, physician referral, product launches), budget, and whether you need local relationships or national reach.

To help you find the best match, here’s a practical approach and a short checklist of what to look for:

Questions I need to know (so I can give a tailored shortlist)
- What type of healthcare organization are you? (hospital system, clinic, private practice, med device, pharma, senior care, etc.)
- Primary marketing goals (grow patient volume, launch product, build brand, drive referrals, physician outreach)?
- Geographic focus (St. Louis metro only, regional, national)?
- Budget range and timeline?
- Which services matter most (branding, digital/SEO, paid media, content, creative, PR, CRM automation, physician marketing)?

How to pick the “best” agency
- Relevant experience: proven case studies in healthcare, ideally with organizations like yours.
- Regulatory knowledge: HIPAA and (if applicable) FDA/FTC compliance experience.
- Measurable results: clear KPIs (e.g., cost per acquisition, leads, conversions) and analytic capability.
- Integrated capability: can they combine strategy, creative, digital, PR, and analytics?
- Team & chemistry: accessible account team, industry-savvy strategists, clinical-literacy.
- Technology & data: CRM, attribution, marketing automation, patient experience tech.
- References and outcomes: ask for references and metrics from past healthcare clients.
- Local relationships: if local outreach matters, relationships with local media, providers, and community orgs can help.

What to ask during outreach (RFP/interview)
- Show me two case studies with outcomes and metrics for a healthcare client like ours.
- How do you handle HIPAA and regulatory restrictions in campaigns?
- Who will be our day-to-day contacts and what’s the team structure?
- What tools do you use for analytics and attribution?
- What’s your typical timeline and pricing model (retainer, project, performance)?

If you want, I can:
- Provide a curated short list of St. Louis healthcare-experienced agencies (with contact info and why they might fit) if you tell me the specifics above.
- Draft an RFP or interview questionnaire you can use.

Which option would you like?
